channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Strasbourg oo si rasmi ah u magacaabtay Vítor Matos, Hugo Oliveira-na wuu tagay
item.description: Kooxda Strasbourg ee Ligue 1 ayaa Arbacadii si rasmi ah ugu dhawaaqday in Vítor Matos oo 38 jir ah, kana yimid Swansea City, uu noqday tababarahooda cusub, kaddib markii ay kala tageen Hugo Oliveira.

item.title: Pew: Islaamku wuxuu 2035 ka gudbi doonaa Masiixiyadda, noqonna doonaa diinta ugu dadka badan adduunka
item.description: Warbixin cusub oo ay soo saartay xarunta cilmi-baarista Pew Research Center ayaa saadaalisay in Islaamku uu sannadka 2035 ka gudbi doono Masiixiyadda, uuna noqon doono diinta ugu dadka badan adduunka.

item.title: Valtteri Bottas oo kursigiisa Cadillac ku sii haynaya xilli ciyaareedka 2027
item.description: Darawalka Finland u dhashay Valtteri Bottas ayaa sii wadi doona inuu u wado kooxda Mareykanka ee Cadillac xilli ciyaareedka 2027 ee Formula 1, kaddib muddo mustaqbalkiisa uu ahaa mid aan la hubin.

item.title: McKennie oo sheegay inuu ku faraxsan yahay Juventus, hadalkiisa Man Utd-na si khaldan loo fahmay
item.description: Ciyaaryahanka khadka dhexe ee Juventus iyo xulka Mareykanka, Weston McKennie, ayaa sheegay in hadalladii uu dhowaan ka sheegay Manchester United si khaldan loo fahmay, isla markaana uu ku faraxsan yahay inuu sii joogo Juventus.

item.title: Real Madrid oo 3-1 kaga adkaatay Inter, Signe Bruun oo laba gool dhalisay
item.description: Kooxda haweenka Real Madrid ayaa Arbacadii garoonka Alfredo Di Stéfano 3-1 kaga adkaatay Inter Milan, kulan ka tirsan Champions League-ka haweenka, iyadoo Signe Bruun ay daqiiqadihii ugu dambeeyay dhalisay laba gool.

item.title: Manchester City oo 2-0 kaga adkaatay Häcken, Hemp iyo Shaw oo dhaliyay
item.description: Kooxda haweenka Manchester City ayaa Arbacadii 2-0 kaga adkaatay BK Häcken oo dalka Sweden ah, kulan ka tirsan wareegga horyaalka Champions League-ka haweenka, iyadoo Lauren Hemp iyo Khadija Shaw ay dhaliyeen goolasha.

item.title: Leicester City oo joojisay heshiiska maalgeliyaha funaanadda BC Game
item.description: Kooxda Leicester City ayaa Arbacadii ku dhawaaqday inay heshiis ku kala tageen shirkadda sharadka internetka ee BC Game, oo funaanaddooda ku qornayd tan iyo 2024, kaddib cabashooyin ka yimid taageerayaasha.

item.title: Rassie Erasmus oo la ganaaxay 6 kulan, kulanka Ireland-na toos ula daawan doona taageerayaasha
item.description: Tababaraha xulka rugby-ga Koonfur Afrika, Rassie Erasmus, oo World Rugby ay 6 kulan ka mamnuucday hoggaaminta Springboks, ayaa qorsheynaya inuu kulanka Ireland ee Sabtida si toos ah internetka ugula daawado taageerayaasha.

item.title: Darajada FIFA: Spain oo hoggaanka haysa, Morocco-na markii ugu horreysay 5-ta sare gashay
item.description: Darajada cusub ee FIFA oo Arbacadii la shaaciyay ayaa Spain ku sii haysa kaalinta 1-aad, Argentina 2-aad iyo Faransiiska 3-aad, halka Morocco ay gashay 5-ta xul ee ugu sarreysa, kana sarreysay Brazil.

item.title: Primož Roglič oo ku biiray kooxda baaskiilka NSN ee Andrés Iniesta
item.description: Baaskiil-wadaha Slovenia u dhashay Primož Roglič oo 37 jir ah ayaa ka tagay Red Bull-Bora-Hansgrohe, wuxuuna heshiis hal sano ah la saxiixday kooxda NSN Cycling, oo uu milkiilayaasheeda ka mid yahay ciyaaryahankii hore ee Spain Andrés Iniesta.

item.title: Sharciga offside-ka ee Wenger oo la filayo in la tuuro kaddib tijaabo Canada
item.description: Sharciga cusub ee offside-ka oo uu soo jeediyay Arsène Wenger, laguna tijaabiyay horyaalka Canada tan iyo bishii April, ayaa la filayaa in aan la dhaqan gelin, sida ay werisay L'Équipe iyadoo soo xiganaysa The New York Times.

item.title: SU’AALO CULUS OO KA DHASHAY KULANKA MUUNGAAB IYO DIBLOMAASIYIINTA IMAARAADKA EE NAIROBI!
item.description: Maxaa ka dambeeyay kulanka qarsoodiga ah ee Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Banaadir, Xasan Maxamed Xuseen Muungaab, uu la yeeshay saraakiil iyo diblomaasiyiin ka tirsan Dowladda Imaaraadka Carabta?

item.title: Kadaga: Uganda kaligeed ma qaadi karto culayska qaxootiga taageero caalami ah la'aanteed
item.description: Ra'iisul wasaare ku-xigeenka koowaad ee Uganda, Rebecca Alitwala Kadaga, ayaa Arbacadii ka digtay in siyaasadda albaabka furan ee dalkeeda aan loo fahmin awood aan xad lahayn, waxayna ku baaqday taageero caalami ah oo badan.

item.title: Maamulaha Juventus Carnevali: Khaladaad ayaa dhacay, dib-u-dhiska waqti ayuu u baahan yahay
item.description: Agaasimaha guud ee Juventus, Giovanni Carnevali, ayaa qirtay in kooxda ay sannadihii la soo dhaafay gashay khaladaad, isla markaana sheegay in heshiiska maaliyadeed ee ay UEFA la leedahay uu xaddidayo awoodda ay ku iibsan karto ciyaartoy.

item.title: Doorashada FIFA: Tashima oo doonaya wadahadal la yeesho Diallo, DFB-na si rasmi ah u taageertay Diallo
item.description: Kozo Tashima oo u tartamaya madaxweynaha FIFA ayaa sheegay inuu doonayo inuu wadahadal la yeesho Philippe Diallo, oo isna u tartamaya xilka, halka Xiriirka Kubbadda Cagta Jarmalka uu si rasmi ah u taageeray Diallo.

item.title: Saddex xildhibaan oo Mareykan ah oo Trump ka codsaday inuu dib u eego cunaqabateynta Rwanda
item.description: Saddex sharci-dejiye oo ka tirsan xisbiga Jamhuuriga ee Mareykanka ayaa warqad ay qoreen 16-ka November ku codsaday in dib loo eego cunaqabateynta Wasaaradda Maaliyadda ay saartay ciidamada iyo Wasaaradda Difaaca ee Rwanda.

item.title: Prem Rugby oo furtay diiwaangelinta kooxaha doonaya inay horyaalka ku biiraan, 12 kooxood 2029-30
item.description: Horyaalka ugu sarreeya ee rugby-ga England, Prem Rugby, ayaa furay diiwaangelin ay kooxaha iyo maalgeliyeyaashu ku muujin karaan rabitaankooda ah inay ku biiraan horyaalka, kaasoo laga doonayo inuu noqdo 12 kooxood xilli ciyaareedka 2029-30.

item.title: Maxkamadda Qaranka Spain oo baaritaan ku furtay eedeymo ka dhan ah fanaanka Julio Iglesias
item.description: Maxkamadda Qaranka ee Spain ayaa baaritaan ku furtay eedeymo ah in fanaanka caanka ah Julio Iglesias uu xadgudub galmo ku sameeyay laba haween ah oo hore ugu shaqayn jiray, sida ay werisay BBC.

item.title: Qaramada Midoobay oo ka walaacday 9 maxbuus oo Somaliland ku fulisay xukun dil ah
item.description: Xafiiska Xuquuqda Aadanaha ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa Arbacadii ka walaac muujiyay 9 nin oo Somaliland ay 11-kii November ku fulisay xukun dil ah, wuxuuna ku baaqay in la hakiyo xukunnada dilka ah ee weli dhiman.

item.title: Seattle Mariners oo Kansas City Royals kala heshiiyay isweydaarsi 6 ciyaartoy ah oo uu ku jiro Maikel Garcia
item.description: Kooxda baseball-ka Seattle Mariners ayaa la sheegay inay ka helayso ciyaaryahanka saldhigga saddexaad Maikel Garcia kooxda Kansas City Royals, isweydaarsi ay ku lug leeyihiin 6 ciyaartoy, inkastoo labada koox aysan weli si rasmi ah u shaacin.

item.title: Goolhayihii hore ee Real Madrid iyo Betis, Antonio Adán, oo 39 jir ku dhawaaqay inuu ka fariistay kubadda cagta
item.description: Goolhayaha reer Spain Antonio Adán, oo ay da'diisu tahay 39 sano, ayaa Arbacadii ku dhawaaqay inuu ka fariistay kubadda cagta xirfadeed, kaddib xirfad uu ku guuleystay 11 koob.

item.title: Wakiilka Guardiola: Pep wuu diiday xulka Mareykanka iyo dalabyada Sacuudiga
item.description: Wakiilka Pep Guardiola, Josep Maria Orobitg, ayaa sheegay in tababaraha reer Spain uusan aqbali doonin shaqada tababaraha xulka Mareykanka, uuna si buuxda u diiday dalabyo ka yimid Sacuudi Carabiya.

item.title: Emma Hayes oo magacowday 23 ciyaartoy oo xulka haweenka Mareykanka ugu qaybgalaya isreebreebka Koobka Adduunka
item.description: Tababaraha xulka haweenka Mareykanka, Emma Hayes, ayaa Arbacadii shaaciyay liis 23 ciyaartoy ah oo ka qaybgalaya Concacaf W Championship, tartanka u ah isreebreebka Koobka Adduunka Haweenka 2027, iyadoo Naomi Girma ay ka maqan tahay dhaawac dartiis.

item.title: Israa'iil oo howlgal dhulka ah ka bilowday bartamaha Gaza iyadoo xabbad joojin ay jirto
item.description: Ciidamada Israa'iil ayaa Arbacadii howlgal dhulka ah ka bilaabay bariga xerada qaxootiga ee Nuseirat ee bartamaha Gaza, deegaan ay Hamas maamusho, taasoo keentay in dad badan ay ka cararaan teendhooyinkooda iyo hoyga ay ku nool yihiin.

item.title: Dowladda Yemen oo sharci cusub ku magacawday Xuutiyiinta urur argagixiso ah
item.description: Golaha Hoggaanka Madaxtooyada Yemen ayaa Arbacadii soo saaray sharci ku tilmaamaya kooxda Xuutiyiinta urur argagixiso ah, kaas oo dambi ka dhigaya howlahooda iyo maalgelintooda, ciqaabtiisuna ay gaarayso dil.

item.title: Antonio Conte: Goor uun xiriirkayga Juventus wuu dhammaystirmi doonaa
item.description: Tababaraha reer Talyaani Antonio Conte, oo hadda aan koox lahayn, ayaa sheegay in maalin uun uu dib ugu laaban doono kursiga tababaraha Juventus, isagoo daaha ka qaaday in laba jeer uu ku dhowaaday inuu kooxda dib ugu soo laabto.

item.title: Dimuqraadiyiinta oo Hakeem Jeffries u magacaabay guddoomiyaha Golaha Wakiilada Mareykanka
item.description: Xildhibaannada Dimuqraadiga ee Golaha Wakiilada Mareykanka ayaa Arbacadii si rasmi ah u magacaabay Hakeem Jeffries inuu noqdo guddoomiyaha golaha, taasoo u xaaraysa inuu noqdo qofkii ugu horreeyay ee madow ah ee hoggaamiya golaha.

item.title: Mucaaradka Soomaaliya iyo mowqifka Imaaraadka: Siyaasad mise dano qaran?
item.description: Waxaa soo baxaya warar sheegaya in xubno ka tirsan mucaaradka Soomaaliyeed oo maanta shir yeeshay ay suuragal tahay inay taageero siyaasadeed u muujiyaan mowqifka Imaaraadka Carabta ee ku aaddan xaaladda Soomaaliya.

item.title: Dallas Cowboys oo Christian Parker kala wareegay hoggaaminta qorshaha difaaca, Mike Pettine oo loo dhiibay
item.description: Dallas Cowboys ayaa isku-duwaha difaaca Christian Parker kala wareegay masuuliyadda u yeerista ciyaaraha difaaca inta kulanku socdo, waxaana xilkaas la wareegaya kaaliyaha sare Mike Pettine.

item.title: Carlos Alcaraz oo 6-2, 6-4 ku garaacay Daniil Medvedev, kuna dhow semi-finalka ATP Finals ee Turin
item.description: Carlos Alcaraz ayaa Arbacadii 6-2, 6-4 kaga adkaaday Daniil Medvedev tartanka ATP Finals ee magaalada Turin, isagoo hadda ku guuleystay labadii kulan ee ugu horreeyay ee kooxdiisa.
